title: orexin-rem-pv: analysis code for a disproportionality analysis of orexin receptor antagonists and REM sleep-related experiences in JADER and FAERS
description: Python code for a disproportionality analysis of individual case safety reports in the Japanese Adverse Drug Event Report database (JADER) and the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS). Reports with a suspected dual orexin receptor antagonist are compared with reports with a suspected benzodiazepine or Z-drug. Events are grouped into tiers by proximity to REM sleep, and reporting odds ratios are estimated with Firth-penalised logistic regression. No data are included; see the README for download steps.
